verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents taking in-person contactless payments, including on a smartphone via Tap to Pay, and its hardware page offers peripherals such as POS Hub. That covers the end state of the story. The evidence says nothing about signup, merchant approval, ordering hardware from the admin dashboard, or how quickly a new merchant can go live. Missing for 10: documented signup and approval flow, in-dashboard hardware ordering, time-to-first-payment evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week

citations.quote: Turn your smartphone into a checkout for on-the-go selling with Tap to Pay.
Tap to Pay works with contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and digital wallets for fast and smooth checkouts.
Add POS Hub to connect your peripherals to your tablet with rock-solid USB connectivity and built-in device monitoring.
